description: For a gross salary in the Netherlands in 2026: compare scenarios that use Dutch tax-free allowances (travel €0.23/km, home office €2.40/day under the WKR) and a company car bijtelling. Returns 3–6 scenarios ranked by true net monthly income, showing which package gives the most take-home pay. Useful during salary negotiations to quantify the value of benefits versus a higher gross.

car_catalog_value.description: Company car catalogue value in euros (0 = no car). Default 0.

car_electric.description: The company car is fully electric. Default false.

car_registration_year.description: First registration year of the EV (rate locks for 60 months). Default current year.

commute_days_year.description: Days commuting per year (for travel allowance). Default 200.

commute_km.description: One-way commute distance in km. Default 0 (no commute).

gross_annual.description: Gross annual salary in euros, without holiday allowance

holiday_allowance_on_top.description: The 8% holiday allowance is on top of the gross. Default false.

home_office_days.description: Days working from home per year (WKR home office allowance €2.40/day). Default 0.

name: compensation_mix_optimizer
title: Dutch compensation package optimizer
